احتسيت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَيْتُ (iḥtasaytu) /iħ.ta.saj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اِحْتَسَيْتَ (iḥtasayta) /iħ.ta.saj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اِحْتَسَيْتِ (iḥtasayti) /iħ.ta.saj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اُحْتُسِيتُ (uḥtusītu) /uħ.tu.siː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
